tools.name: mintsoft_list_clients
tools.description: List clients (the customers of a 3PL warehouse). Mintsoft: GET /api/Client.

tools.name: mintsoft_list_warehouses
tools.description: List warehouses with their ids. Use the ids for stock and order filters. Mintsoft: GET /api/Warehouse.

tools.name: mintsoft_list_courier_services
tools.description: List courier services with ids (for the order filter CourierServiceId). Mintsoft: GET /api/Courier/Services.

tools.name: mintsoft_list_order_statuses
tools.description: List order statuses with ids (for the order filter OrderStatusId). Mintsoft: GET /api/Order/Statuses.

tools.name: mintsoft_list_asn_statuses
tools.description: List ASN (inbound shipment) statuses with ids. Mintsoft: GET /api/ASN/Statuses.

tools.name: mintsoft_list_orders
tools.description: List orders, newest first unless sort_oldest_first. Filter by status, client, warehouse, courier service, dates and tags. Use a 0 id for 'all'. Mintsoft: GET /api/Order/List.

tools.name: mintsoft_search_orders
tools.description: Find orders by order number, tracking number or external order reference. Returns up to 10 orders, newest first. Mintsoft: GET /api/Order/Search.

tools.name: mintsoft_get_order
tools.description: Get one order by its Mintsoft order id, with address, status, courier and items. Mintsoft: GET /api/Order/{id}.

tools.name: mintsoft_get_order_comments
tools.description: List the comments on an order. Mintsoft: GET /api/Order/{id}/Comments.

tools.name: mintsoft_get_order_shipments
tools.description: List the shipments of an order (courier, tracking numbers, parcels). Mintsoft: GET /api/Order/{id}/Shipments.

tools.name: mintsoft_list_products
tools.description: List products (SKUs), 100 per page. Mintsoft: GET /api/Product/List.

tools.name: mintsoft_search_products
tools.description: Search products by SKU or name. Mintsoft: GET /api/Product/Search.

tools.name: mintsoft_get_product
tools.description: Get one product by its Mintsoft product id. Mintsoft: GET /api/Product/{id}.

tools.name: mintsoft_get_stock_levels
tools.description: Get stock levels, optionally for one warehouse, product or SKU, with a breakdown by batch, serial or best-before date. Mintsoft: GET /api/Product/StockLevels.

tools.name: mintsoft_get_product_inventory
tools.description: Get the inventory records (locations and quantities) of one product. Mintsoft: GET /api/Product/{id}/Inventory.

tools.name: mintsoft_list_stock_movements
tools.description: List the stock movements in one warehouse, optionally for one product or since a date. Mintsoft: GET /api/Warehouse/{id}/StockMovements.

tools.name: mintsoft_list_asns
tools.description: List ASNs (advance shipping notices: inbound stock). Mintsoft: GET /api/ASN/List.

tools.name: mintsoft_get_asn
tools.description: Get one ASN by id, with items and status. Mintsoft: GET /api/ASN/{id}.

tools.name: mintsoft_list_returns
tools.description: List customer returns. Mintsoft: GET /api/Return/List.

tools.name: mintsoft_get_return
tools.description: Get one return by id. Mintsoft: GET /api/Return/{id}.

tools.name: mintsoft_add_order_comment
tools.description: WRITE: add a comment to an order. Each call adds one more comment (not idempotent). Set admin true for an internal admin comment. Mintsoft: POST /api/Order/{id}/Comments.

tools.name: mintsoft_add_order_tag
tools.description: WRITE: add a tag to an order. Adding a tag that exists is safe to repeat. Mintsoft: PUT /api/Order/{id}/Tag?Tag=.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: mintsoft_get_order_comments · Private data: mintsoft_get_product_inventory · Public sink: mintsoft_add_order_comment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: mintsoft_get_order_comments · Private data: mintsoft_get_product_inventory · Public sink: mintsoft_add_order_comment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
